review_description: Salesman was prompt and realistic about options available.Provided options and advice on pricing, was excellent to deal with,Installers were neat and tidy.Provided what was asked for in options.

From the initial scoping of the project to install solar and battery system, PDR representatives were very helpful, polite and honest. The person who did the initial visit explained the different options for solar panels and batteries, helped me in locating the best location for the battery, explained the process and answered all my questions. The quote was sent to me immediately with a couple of options to choose from including the data sheets of the products for me to investigate and consider in making my decision.During the installation day, the young men who arrived to do the job were polite and explained the scope of work to me. They were tidy. Although they encountered some challenges as my house is double storey, which delayed completion of the job. They needed to come back two more times to finish the job and get the system working. Although I saw that they did their job with care, I noticed some scuff marks on my walls and ceiling in the garage and even inside the house  (by the stairs) as they needed to bring a ladder to access the second storey ceiling.The battery was installed on the first day. It looked really neat and tidy with the Gateway sitting above the battery. I was impressed with the workmanship. However, an error was made in the install of the battery. They completed the install with one battery module more than required. This meant that they had to remove one extra battery module the following day thus exposing the conduits and the holes on the wall, making the battery set-up looking less tidy. The app was also set-up with the extra battery module, which still needed to be updated.Despite all the challenges and the amount of work that the team needs to do in other job sites, they went back to address the remaining issues to be able to get the solar and battery system up and running. I'm thankful for their commitment to complete the job at my house even if it meant returning outside their normal working hours.

PDR were great to deal with. The salesman was knowledgeable, answered all our questions and worked with us to find the best system for our budget. Installation was just as easy. The weather wasn’t ideal, but they pushed on and completed it to a high standard. The panels look great and the system was explained in detail. Grid connection was organized prior to installation and was just something I didn’t need to worry about.

No problems with the initial quote, the work was completed relatively quickly  and handed over in good working order.There are some minor problems with the Redback App dropping out, this would seem to be a Redback problem, and I have requested their contact number from PDR.Grid connectivity via the smart meter requires a wait period of 8-10 weeks for the adjustment.Ridiculous....

PRD sent out Damien to discuss my objectives. I ended up with 5 quotes and in the end Damien recommended quality products at a fair price which included additional panels and battery capacity. Very happy as was installed within two weeks. I love the Sungrow ISolarCloud app.

We got a 13kw system and inverter. A few little hick ups along the way with installation and connection but the guys from PDR have been very fast to resolve everything asap, and never left us feeling stranded. Everyone was very polite, on time and they cleaned up after themselves. Definitely recommend.
Fantastic installation great after installation service and our electricity bill has gone from $700 a month to $100!

They may not of been the cheapest but were still competitive for quality products. I felt comfortable knowing I was going to be looked after by a professional company dealing only with quality products and installation. The power generation of the system is excellent.
I went with REC panels and sungrow 3 phase inverter.  The company was organised, efficient, and was installed within a week of accepting a quote.

Received quote quickly and installation within a week.The installation team arrived in time and was efficient and polite.Our first solar so would have liked a bit more info but the basics were shown to us. Overall it all went smoothly.

The sales and quoting process was outstanding - the salesperson had a great understanding of solar and the products available. Once across my needs, I didn't try to upsell unnecessary products/features.The installation did have some miscommunication with scheduling, but it was understandable, given the typical organiser was away that week. The guys quickly picked up the slack once they were aware and did a fantastic job.Post-installation, the guys were still responsive and helped me fix some problems with the app (which wasn't their responsibility).Overall, they are an outstanding local team; I recommend them.

The sales and quoting process went seamlessly, but that's where the pleasant experience ended. I had to proactively contact the company to get updates on the status of my installation. The agreed-upon solar system was changed from a 6.6 kW system to a 5.6 kW system due to roof size constraints. After agreeing to the updated system, I was informed two days before installation that the panels were out of stock.The installation itself went relatively well, although one panel was scratched, and I am still waiting for a resolution on this issue. The solar system worked for less than a day before a fault appeared, which took three days to fix due to installation issues. The company failed to show up on the scheduled day without any communication and arrived two hours late the following day after several phone calls and messages from my end.The only proactive phone call I received from the owner was regarding payment. Three weeks have passed, and the system is still not connected to the grid.
Very good, polite tidy and punctual they organised the grid connection I didn't have to do a thing.

The battery is a Energizer HP-6M and HP-06, it is a phosphoric acid iron lithium salt battery, it is a 6.1kw system.Since installation it has been cloudy and raining and not ideal for solar generation, but the battery reports self sufficiency  at 94% for day 1, 64% for day 2 and 66% for day three.We are expecting much greater things when the sun final shines, we do live in the sunshine state.The installation was delayed a few weeks due to the need for Qld Government approval for rebate but once approval was gained the battery was installed a few days later.PDR took care of dealing with the grid power provider.One electrician and two apprentices did the installation, there were no dramas.The battery is mounted to a wall bracket and is not going anywhere it ways a ton ( 100+ kg ).There are two backup circuits of 15 Amps each when the power goes down.This is not the biggest battery in the world, it's primary use is to allow us to use our solar power during the day and night and also to keep our fridge and freezer alive during the next Queensland blackout.

Quoting process went smoothly, very informative.Install was difficult, we have a very high roof which put off the installers initially when they arrived onsite. It was also a rainy day which made things more difficult for them. They persisted and got the job done in one day, although the electrical install looked rushed and unprofessional. I had to call the company back to rectify some of the rushed work, which they did promptly without complaint and to a reasonable standard.System has worked perfectly since install.
Best price, installed in a day, came on time and finished panels and inverter appears well installed.  Left no rubbish behind.
They did a great job. That's all.I'm a very critical customer and I would definitely hire PDR for any future installs.

The quote process from PDR was very efficient and detailed and easy to understand. The installation started early and finished on time by a team of workers who were very tidy.We had a minor issue with the grid connection but this was rectified by Pat. All up, we are very pleased with the quality products selected and the tidy finish at a reasonable cost.
The sales process was great, Damien is very knowledgeable and experienced.  The install went well they were polite and punctual.

Sales and quoting was friendly and competitively priced.Installation was quick and professional.Customer service was greatThey helped organise the new electrical meter so that we could get the solar running.

Sales/Quoting was well planned, punctual and very professionalInstallation was very professional / tidy / great standards, great example of what good looks likeCustomer service was great, would not ask for more.

Quoting process and salesperson was fantastic. Got a number of quotes to compare which was top notch. Prices offered were by far the best in class (in comparison to other established companies)Installation had a hiccup with installing of a not so common but already quoted inverter feature however it was quickly and efficiently sorted out. Also there is an accidental hole/damage to the interior wall which is yet to be fixed by them (was a bit hurt by this as this is a brand new house with no such damages yey). No major complains apart from that and the office was easy to reach out for any questions at any time.The peak performance of the system however has not been reaching according to the quoting proposal which has been brought up but I am waiting for more days/data to really escalate it. Finally the panel layout on the quote vs the install was different probably due to circumstances but I was not told on the install day (or any day) and I only noticed this being different after a week as my panels are normally not visible at all due to completely being on the neighbors side. The install was very neat and clean and no major complains there too.Grid connection and meter change was organised by them. Have I mentioned about the price yet because the price they offered was by far the best (by a lot) compared to the rest.Overall happy with PDR Energy and hoping to get continued support in the future from them - have also already recommended them to a number of my friends

Very happen with my system. The quoting process was thorough and friendly. Pat from PDR was especially helpful and explained everything.I also spoke to another solar company which was larger and quoted a similar price for an identical system, but I found them arrogant and somewhat condescending, but the PDR team were great!Installation was smooth easy including organising an install of a completely new meter box and switchboard. They organised the new smart meter via the distributor and retailer as well.

PDR was the first company to call me after signing up with solar quotes.  Patrick was very easy to talk to and offered a range of options.  He wasn't the cheapest, but his price was great for midrange quality gear (Fronius inverter & Trina 400w panels).  He booked me in for the first week back in January and confirmed on the day that the team was coming out.  They showed up on time and were clean, tidy and professional.  Cabling needed to be run from one side of my house to the other and it was very neatly done in conduit and tucked up out of the way.  I know they used a lot more cable and conduit than expected, but I wasn't hit with any extra charges.  They explained to me how to connect to the grid and showed me how the Fronius app worked etc.

Most knowledgeable company I dealt with in the quoting process and responsive to my requirements,  provided clear, well presented quotation and responded promptly  to the questions I had.The neat and tidy installation was well considered and explained by the friendly staff.They included a hot water timer and  an EV outlet installed in garage.
Great staff from getting the quote to the install. Couldn’t rate the boys high enough. Very professional outfit.

The boys who came out and did the work were excellent, they explained everything really well, however hooking up with the app and getting connected by Energex and then my supplier was a bit ordinary. I asked a few questions from the installer which never got answered, I was left to work it out by myself which I eventually did. So, a bit more work on the after market customer service is required.
